This Writ Petition has been filed to direct the respondents to pay compensation under the Tamil Nadu Fair Compensation Act, 2014 or to give appointment to the petitioners 2 and 3 or to return the lands to the petitioners by permitting them to cancel the Gift Deed dated 24.10.2013.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis and W.M.P.Nos.3790 & 3792 of 2024 2

. Heard Mr.R.Singaaravelan, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners,
Mr.A.Selvendran, learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents 1, 4 & 5,
Mr.Su.Srinivasan, learned Standing Counsel for the second respondent and Mr.M.Venkateswaran,
learned Special Government Pleader (Tax) for the third respondent.
3. The grievance of the petitioners is that, the first petitioner executed a registered Gift Deed in favour of the third respondent, for the purpose of establishing Toll Booth in Survey No.286/1 to an extent of 12 cents at Chinnamatarapalli Village, Bargur Taluk, Krishnagiri District and the same has not been established and hence, they seek a direction to pay compensation or to return back the lands.

sentences.text: Counter filed by the second respondent to the effect that he is not a necessary party.
The fifth respondent has filed counter to the effect that no acquisition was made and the writ petitioners have been cultivating the property even now.
The first respondent has also filed counter to the effect that the land has not been acquired.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis and W.M.P.Nos.3790 & 3792 of 2024 5

. The learned Special Government Pleader (Tax) for the third respondent would submit that the purpose for which the gift deed was obtained has not been achieved and they no longer require the said land for establishing the Toll Booth and they are ready to reconvey the property to the petitioners within a reasonable time.

6. In such view of the matter, there shall be a direction to the third respondent to reconvey the property to the petitioners within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
7. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
